seoTitle: Content Freshness Audit: Outdated Years, Versions and Phrases
metaDescription: Paste an article and find what has gone stale: old years, "this year" phrases, software versions, undated statistics and copyright dates, with a refresh checklist.
intro: Find the parts of an article that have aged and get a checklist for refreshing it.
why:
Old content loses rankings and trust quietly. This audit scans the text for years older than a threshold you set, relative-time words ("this year", "recently", "currently"), software versions, pandemic wording, statistics with no date and old copyright years, shows the context of each hit and ends with a refresh checklist covering dates, schema, sources and links.

It is pattern matching: it cannot tell whether a statement is still true, so use the hits as a to-do list and verify each against a current source.
howTo: Paste the article text or HTML.
Set the current year and the age threshold.
Work through the hits and the checklist.

faq.a: No. It finds places that are likely to be outdated.

faq.q: Will updating the date help rankings?
faq.a: Only if the content really changed; fake freshness does not help.
